plain_description: Axolotl lets you fine-tune the best open-source LLMs on your own data — no vendor lock-in, no per-seat fees. Get production-quality custom models using your existing GPU hardware with one-click Docker deployment and built-in support for the latest training techniques. Train faster, cheaper, and keep full control of your intellectual property.
technical_description: Axolotl is an open-source CLI framework for fine-tuning and post-training large language models. Built on PyTorch, it supports full fine-tuning, LoRA/QLoRA, preference tuning (DPO, KTO, ORPO), reinforcement learning (GRPO, GDPO), and quantization (GPTQ, QAT, NVFP4). It integrates with Hugging Face Hub for datasets and models, supports multi-GPU and multi-node training via FSDP1/FSDP2, DeepSpeed, and torchrun, and ships as both a PyPI package and a Docker image. Key capabilities include Flash Attention 2/3/4, multipacking, sequence parallelism, and custom kernel integrations (Liger, Cut Cross Entropy, ScatterMoE, SonicMoE) for maximizing throughput on NVIDIA and AMD GPUs.
title: Axolotl
